constraints.message: Metro splits Display Cost from Printing and Mounting because the mounting figure is large enough that the client is shown it.
Route is not in the master. Leave it blank for the desk. Never generate or infer a route.
The printing and mounting option value is a single lump per line. Divide it down to per unit for the addon_per_unit column.
constraints.source: pricing_option_values, for example Delhi Metro Line 2 at 1149000

scenarios.message: Below 5 lakh a metro buy yields very little. Bus or auto gives wider reach for the same money.

do: Read the line off the price option name where the master names one, such as Aqua Line.
Strip the city and line from the price option name to fill the Media Package column.
dont: Never state a route, a train number or a train name. The desk fills these.
